# 1 Clement Chapter 57 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 57 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_057_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 57

**57:1** Therefore, you who laid the foundation of the sedition, submit yourselves to the presbyters and accept correction toward repentance, bending the knees of your heart.

**57:2** Learn to be subordinate, laying aside the arrogant and proud boasting of your tongue. For it is better for you to be found humble within the flock of Christ and honorable, than to seem pre-eminent and be cast out from his hope.

**57:3** For thus the all-excellent Wisdom says: "Behold, I will bring forth to you the declaration of my spirit; I will instruct you in my word.

**57:4** Since I called and you did not obey, and I stretched forth my words and you gave no heed, and you made light of my counsels and did not attend to my reproofs,

**57:5** therefore I too will laugh at your destruction, and I will rejoice when ruin comes upon you, and when sudden confusion overtakes you, and when devastation rushes upon you like a storm, and when distress and affliction come upon you.

**57:6** For it shall be that when you call upon me I shall not hear you; evil men will seek me and shall not find me. For they hated wisdom and would not choose the fear of the LORD,

**57:7** neither would they attend to my counsels, but mocked my reproofs.

**57:8** Therefore they shall eat the fruits of their own way, and shall be sated with their own impiety.

**57:9** For because they wronged the innocent, they shall be slain; and judgment shall destroy the ungodly.

**57:10** But the one who listens to me shall dwell in confidence, and shall rest in hope undisturbed by fear of any evil."

---

*LOGOS renders according to the standard Greek text of Codex Alexandrinus with attention to formal correspondence.*
